snippet.title: HipWitch - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Download & Play HipWitch Now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701460/HipWitch/
Itch.io: https://studiohipsword.itch.io/hipwitch

HipWitch is a chill puzzle game that invites you to explore a beautiful nature reserve. Play as Prom, a young witch helping a cast of quirky characters. Use a variety of spells, and the power of 90s dial-up internet to solve the tasks ahead! 

--
Follow Studio Hip Sword:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/StudioHipSword​
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/studiohipsword/
​Discord: https://discord.gg/vynneRmvu8
